acceptance: the verdict is one of the four predeclared labels, computed by the sealed test from the six sealed cells with no threshold or rule chosen after seeing the verdict run

RECORDED.meaning: the six sealed WS-PROP-1 cells; no new simulation, no new construction

authority: owner 2026-09-19 P9 (question tool): timing-sensitive trajectory divergence with the g=0 causal null. Authorized in manifests/todo.json as HD-PROPAGATION-OBSERVABLE

estimator.d: per area, mean over its groups of the absolute ON minus OFF difference of the 10 ms-binned group rate series (L1 over groups); the retained resolution, not a choice
estimator.null: the held-out g=0 replicate pair (g000_on_s1 vs g000_off_s1); the same-seed matched design makes g=0 downstream trajectories bit-identical, so any positive divergence there is signal
estimator.onset: first 10 ms bin where d exceeds the threshold for 5 consecutive bins (50 ms sustained, not a single-bin spike)
estimator.series: series_rate_hz per group from each cell's sealed npz (133 groups, 1300 bins of 10 ms)
estimator.threshold: the maximum downstream per-bin divergence of the held-out g=0 replicate pair plus a 1e-12 float-noise floor

principal_delta: the observable only: matched ON/OFF trajectory divergence replaces the window-count contrast. No model parameter, drive, delay, HDP state or architecture value changes because nothing is re-run
question: when does the stimulus first cause the reachable system trajectory to diverge from its matched control, per area, with the disconnected control as the causal null
stop_condition: one evaluation, then STOP. No model change, no HDP, no delay, no oscillator experiment, no velocity claim, no monotonic amplification claim

verdicts.PROPAGATION_DETECTED_ORDERED: V1_1 detects in the test pair, every downstream g=0 null reads at most the threshold, and at least one downstream area detects at g=0.5; onset ordering reported
verdicts.PROPAGATION_ABSENT_AT_G05: controls pass but no downstream area detects at g=0.5
verdicts.PROPAGATION_NULL_FAILED: a downstream g=0 null exceeds the threshold: the matched-seed determinism the design relies on does not hold
verdicts.PROPAGATION_V1_UNDETECTED: V1_1 does not detect in the test pair: the instrument is blind even at the injection point

visualization_contract.reason: read-only analysis of six sealed WS-PROP-1 cells; no construction built and no simulation run
